title: MF0-1984: Long-Term Memory for Multimodal AI Agents
summary: An open-source, local-first AI agent orchestrator that uses hierarchical 3D knowledge graphs and conversation rollups to manage long-term memory. It prioritizes data privacy and supports multiple LLM providers via the Model Context Protocol.
research_notes: Created by Pavel Muntyan (Mr. Freeman creator); emphasizes a 'sovereign-by-design' approach where all data remains in a local SQLite database.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from a memory-focused framework to a comprehensive 'Digital Partner' ecosystem with 3D memory visualization and autonomous workflow orchestration.
